meta.description: Access federal and state contracting guides, SAM.gov UEI checklists, capability statement templates, and NAICS classification directories on EVOConnected.

fields.title: Vendor Readiness & Compliance Library
fields.subtitle: Templates, checklists, and procurement references engineered to prepare workers, subcontractors, and primes for government contract awards.

cards.title: Worker & Independent Subcontractor Checklist
cards.body: Step-by-step protocol for OSHA/CDL credential verification, LLC formation, EIN issuance, and SAM.gov UEI registration.

cards.title: Federal NAICS Classification Matrix
cards.body: Explore all 58 federal 6-digit NAICS codes mapped to 22 infrastructure and skilled trade categories.

cards.title: Worker Readiness FAQ
cards.body: Answers to common questions about prevailing wage (Davis-Bacon), NAICS matching, and prime contractor recruitment.

cards.title: One-Page Capability Statement Builder
cards.body: Generate a print-ready, federal contracting officer-compliant capability statement directly from your business profile.

cards.title: Subcontractor Certification & SAM.gov Track
cards.body: Guided checklist covering SAM.gov UEI activation, DBE/MBE/WBE/HUB/SDVOSB/8(a) filings, and bonding readiness.

cards.title: Subcontractor Compliance FAQ
cards.body: Detailed guidance on socioeconomic set-asides, prime RFQ responses, and hiring verified labor crews.

cards.title: Targeted RFQ & Solicitation Standards
cards.body: Best practices for publishing NAICS-targeted RFQs and documenting good-faith socioeconomic outreach.

cards.title: Prime Diversity Spend FAQ
cards.body: Learn how EVOConnected streamlines DBE, HUB, SDVOSB, and 8(a) subcontractor discovery and compliance reporting.

fields.heading: Need Direct Compliance Assistance?
fields.text: Our Executive Support & Compliance Desk assists workers, small businesses, and primes with onboarding and NAICS alignment.
